contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTA[--]NVS[--] CAES ; R/ CAE[SARVM N]OS[TROR]V[M]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly of Constantine II (317-340) though obverse legend may forbid this, Caesarum Nostrorum issue of 321-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Head laureate right. Obverse inscription: CONSTA[--]NVS[--] CAES. Reverse description: Vow in wreath enclosing legend VOT / V. Reverse inscription: CAE[SARVM N]OS[TROR]V[M].
